patches.field: terms[5](ブルーオーシャン戦略).analogy_jp
patches.before: まだ誰も来ていない沖の漁場を自分で見つけるようなもの。
patches.after: 何もなかった沖に魚の集まる魚礁を沈めて、誰もいない新しい漁場を自分で作り出すようなもの。
patches.reason: Rule A M1 比喩が既存市場の発見 (ニッチ寄り) と読め、創出の判別点と逆

patches.field: terms[5](ブルーオーシャン戦略).analogy_zh
patches.before: 而是自己去找一片还没人来过的远海渔场。
patches.after: 而是在原本什么都没有的远海沉下聚鱼的鱼礁，亲手造出一片没有别人的新渔场。
patches.reason: Rule A M1

patches.field: terms[5](ブルーオーシャン戦略).analogy_en
patches.before: and finding your own offshore ground where no one has come yet.
patches.after: and sinking an artificial reef in empty water offshore, so that you create a brand-new fishing ground with no one else on it.
patches.reason: Rule A M1

patches.before: 挑戦者の動きにすぐ追随できる
patches.after: 挑戦者の動きにすぐ対抗できる
patches.reason: Rule A L1 フォロワーの定義語

patches.before: to follow a challenger's moves right away
patches.after: to match a challenger's moves right away
patches.reason: Rule A L1

patches.field: terms[5](ブルーオーシャン戦略).one_en
patches.before: create a **market with no competitors** of its own.
patches.after: create, by itself, a **market with no competitors**.
patches.reason: Rule A L2

patches.after: 日语「優位」二字的字面意思是“优越的位置”。
